verdict.rationale: Expensify ships an in-product AI assistant that handles plain-language expense actions, so asking whether it can plug in external MCP servers is a fair question. However, nothing in the evidence shows it can connect to MCP servers or use their tools. Its OAuth/API, accounting integrations, and the repo's /agent-device dev skill are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
